status: IMPLEMENTATION / ISOLATED VERIFICATION PASS; LIVE USE HOLD (explicit user decision)

discovery.owner_cli: init/patch delegate to existing constructor, applyPatch, validation, saveProject in withCanonicalWriter
discovery.snapshot_precondition: not provided by CLI; new adapter compares exact fingerprint inside owner session before applyPatch
discovery.transitions: existing canonical status enum; core patch allows status updates without a transition graph. Start/complete is a narrower endpoint policy, not new core semantics
discovery.idempotency: patch timestamps mean repeat application is not byte-idempotent. Compare-and-reject precondition plus current-status check prevents duplicate mutation; no automatic retry or request-ID model
discovery.atomic_save: existing same-directory temp/rename contract; not a power-loss durability promise

endpoint.denied: Historical / proof / unregistered / arbitrary paths; raw patches and extra fields rejected
endpoint.unchanged: CurrentState, primary_next_action_id, goal/dependency refs, titles, descriptions, due dates, priorities, canonical order
endpoint.owner: ground-local-cli-v0; acquire/read/check/apply/save/read/release; finally on errors; no stale lock removal
endpoint.schema: 0.1.25 only and stored/read equality required; no migration

activation.runtime: existing GROUND_RUNTIME_CONFIG absolute config with canonical-live root and owner
activation.request_guard: loopback peer + exact Origin + Host + same-origin Sec-Fetch-Site when supplied + JSON intent; no forwarded-header trust
activation.authority_limit: local OS-owner use only; no remote/multi-user deployment authorization
activation.isolated_smoke: http://localhost:3018/ using temporary isolated root only

presentation.controls: Start / Mark done only for enabled scope and pending/in_progress; done/cancelled read-only
presentation.confirmation: no extra dialog: explicit status-only action, no execution; pending submit locked and stale/error snapshot cannot resubmit
presentation.groups: Active / collapsed Completed / collapsed Cancelled; within-group stored order; no priority claim
presentation.density: title/status primary; description/due_at and raw expand
presentation.success: write receipt then fresh Operating GET; no optimistic canonical status
presentation.failure: local Project alert, no automatic retry; reload required; unknown outcome or saved-but-read-failed are explicit

auditability.retention: response receipt and structured server operation log. No new canonical history model; deployments must retain operation logs if cross-session receipt retention is required. Snapshot alone does not retain previous fingerprints.

verification.skip_note: live-dependent skips covered by explicit live read subsets; counts overlap
browser_isolated: external writer change -> SNAPSHOT_MISMATCH, status not changed
verification.browser_live: Business and Historical read; existing done Action in Completed; write remains disabled
verification.test_correction: BIZ002A expanded catalog from 4 to 5; old live UI catalog expectation updated; grouping assertion updated for explicit new presentation

remaining.live_use: HOLD: only existing done Action; user confirmed no target and live-only HOLD; no Action generated/reopened
remaining.CLI_free: isolated browser progression proven; real daily workflow not yet proven
remaining.next_missing_feature: not established without next real use
remaining.blocking_issue: human-decided existing pending/in_progress Action required for live use
